text:
ashley: FYI sales escalated Ledgerly—production Dedicated pool saw ~1.2% 503s during peak KST window. They want an ETA and whether we'll hotfix or include in next release.
sam-support: Customer reported failures started after yesterday's runtime tweak to kv-cache eviction. Logs point to OOM in worker-2 then 503s. Attaching snippets.
mikhail: logs look like overflow on small-batch path, possibly new kernel path. Prioritized triage. @kevin-prod can you confirm if we reverted the kernel selection flag in canary?
kevin-prod: Canary still on new kernel. We didn't roll forward cluster-wide. I can flip the runtime flag for Ledgerly's dedicated pool to legacy kernels — needs a config change and warm restart (~10m) if approved.
jordan: What's the SLA impact? Legal asked for scope of service credits if we don't fix within 24h.
ashley: Ledgerly on enterprise plan, 99.95% SLA. They hit a 30m window of degraded success rate, might qualify. We should aim for hotfix if low-risk.
priya: Quick risk assessment: reverting kernel selection is low-risk but may increase latency by ~5-10ms. Rolling a code hotfix to kernel is higher risk and needs validation.
sam-support: Ledgerly wants a patch asap or clear comms + mitigation. They're okay with a short restart during low-traffic (02:00 UTC) but want notice.
kevin-prod: I propose: 1) apply per-customer runtime flag to revert kernel for their pool now as emergency config (no code deploy). 2) schedule a validated hotfix to runtime in next release if regression persists. 3) post-mortem and SLA calc.
ashley: Agreed. Need signoff from product + infra. @mikhail, can infra run the change now? If can't, schedule 02:00 UTC window and send comms to Ledgerly.
mikhail: I can run the flag flip now; will prep commands and rollback plan. Command is:
```
redwood-cli patch-dedicated --customer ledgerly --set runtime.kernel=legacy
```
I'll dry-run on staging then patch prod.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for per-customer flag change by mikhail. Dry-run success. No code artifacts changed.
kevin-prod: After flip, monitor 30m for error rate and latency. If stable, we mark incident mitigated and plan hotfix in next patch release.
ashley: I'll draft comms: immediate mitigation applied, expected latency delta, rollback plan, and ETA for full fix. Sam, can you send to Ledgerly once we confirm stability?
sam-support: Yep. I'll prepare the message and hold until mikhail gives green.
priya: Note for roadmap: add regression test for kernel transitions on dedicated pools to avoid future surprises.
ashley: Thanks — continue updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
